test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2025 - General Knowledge (Held On: 15th_September_2025_Shift_3)
subject: general
question:
**Consider the following statements about Gita Upadhyay:**

1. She is a Hindi writer from Assam.

2. She translated The Diary of Anne Frank into Indian languages.

3. She was conferred the Padma Bhushan in 2025.

Which of the above statements is/are **correct**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 2 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gita Upadhyay** is a noted **Hindi writer from Assam** who has contributed significantly to Hindi literature and literary translation. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• She is known for translating several literary works, including **“The Diary of Anne Frank”**, into Indian languages to make the work accessible to a wider audience. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• In **2025**, she was honored with the **Padma Shri**, not the **Padma Bhushan**. Therefore, the statement mentioning Padma Bhushan is incorrect. ***Hence, statement 3 is not correct.***
 
• **Padma Awards** are among the highest civilian honours in India and are announced annually on the eve of **Republic Day**.
 
• **Statement-wise Analysis:**
 
 
• **Statement 1** – Correct.
 
• **Statement 2** – Correct.
 
• **Statement 3** – Incorrect.
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Statements 1 and 2 only.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Awards:** India’s civilian awards include **Bharat Ratna**, **Padma Vibhushan**, **Padma Bhushan**, and **Padma Shri**.
 
• **Padma Shri** is awarded for distinguished service in fields such as **literature, education, arts, science, social work, and public affairs**.
 
• **Anne Frank** was a Jewish girl whose diary documented her experiences during the **Second World War** and the **Nazi occupation**.
 
• **The Diary of Anne Frank** is one of the world’s most translated and widely read autobiographical works.
 
• **Assam** has contributed significantly to Indian literature through works in **Assamese, Hindi, Bengali, and regional dialects**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Translation literature** plays an important role in spreading global literary works into regional Indian languages.
 
• Questions related to **Padma Award recipients** and notable literary personalities are frequently asked in competitive examinations.
